page0.text:
I can't block them.
Well, I can at least manage to avoid them.
But I'm not sure I can dodge them and attack Shinji.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-05:page0:1

page1.text:
The three sharp blades approach.
"...Nnh, fuh!"
I stop in my tracks, and concentrate on evading, keeping an eye on Shinji.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-05:page1:1

page2.text:
I take a step to the left to dodge the blade that rushes towards my stomach.
I twist my upper body to avoid the second blade coming towards my chest from the left after I avoid the first blade, and then I rush forward to pass the third blade flying at my unprotected forehead!
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-05:page2:1

page3.text:
"Not a problem. I can see where they're going!"
Compared to Saber's attacks, this is like a game of dodgeball.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-05:page3:1

page4.text:
"Tch!!! You conceited fool!"
Three more shadows rush toward me.
I don't even need to see where these are going.
The first attack showed me how far and fast these can go, so I have no trouble avoiding this attack.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-05:page4:1
